instructions.label: Jev 3D glitch check
instructions.text: Before you finish, run the Jev 3D glitch check on the screens this change touches: `npm run build`, then `node scripts/qa-screens.mjs --routes=<the activity or screen names>` and `node scripts/qa-oddities.mjs --routes=<the same>` (the key comes from the main checkout's .env; it stops at a $0.75 cap per run; if it does, ask me before going further). Look at qa-output/oddities/summary.md and its contact sheets, fix every red box that is a real bug, check the maybes yourself, and put the sheet and one line per finding (fixed, or why it's not a bug) on the review page.
